turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Look: today I buy a bag. Yesterday I bought a bag. The verb "buy" changes its whole word.
Rule: Some verbs change their whole word in the past, and we do not add -ed.
Right: Yesterday I went to the shop. Wrong: Yesterday I goed to the shop.
Now you try:
Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
